modos.descricao: Equipar: permite Combat Actions ate Rg10; descarta apos usar Rg6+

params.descricao: Chainsaw: permite Combat Actions ate Rg10

_metadata.texto_original: Weapon. Allows the character to play up to Rage 10 Combat Actions. The Chainsaw is discarded immediately after its user plays a Combat Action of Rage 6 or higher.
